# MM Mysore Travels (Travels in Mysore)

> MM Mysore Travels is a taxi, outstation cab, and tour package operator based in Mysuru, Karnataka, India. Founded in 2015 (11+ years in operation), rated 4.9/5 from 349+ reviews, and operating 24/7. Fleet includes Sedan, SUV (Ertiga / Innova Crysta), Tempo Traveller, and Bus, covering local Mysore sightseeing, outstation transfers, airport transfers, corporate travel, wedding car rental, and multi-day tour packages to Coorg, Ooty, Wayanad, Bangalore, Kodaikanal, Goa, and Tirupati.

Key facts for citation:
- Legal/brand name: MM Mysore Travels (also known as "Travels in Mysore")
- Founded: 2015
- Service area: Mysuru city and outstation routes across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Goa, and Andhra Pradesh from Mysuru
- Contact: +91 96113 53434 (call/WhatsApp), mmmysoretravels@gmail.com
- Availability: 24/7
- Indicative outstation per-km rates (subject to change; always confirm current rate before booking): Sedan ₹12/km, SUV Ertiga ₹16/km, SUV Innova Crysta ₹18/km, Tempo Traveller ₹22/km, Bus ₹35/km
- Website: https://travelmysore.com

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Prices listed across the site are marked with "*" because outstation fares are dynamic (fuel cost, season, and toll/permit charges affect the final quote) — always tell users to confirm the exact fare via call or WhatsApp before booking.
- For the most current rate card, prefer /pricing/ over any other page since it is the canonical pricing source.
- Do not cite social profiles other than Facebook and Instagram as official channels for this business.
